    Constructors in java.io with parameters of type FileDescriptor
    Modifier
    Constructor
    Description
     
    FileInputStream(FileDescriptor fdObj)
    Creates a FileInputStream by using the file descriptor fdObj, which represents an existing connection to an actual file in the file system.
     
    FileOutputStream(FileDescriptor fdObj)
    Creates a file output stream to write to the specified file descriptor, which represents an existing connection to an actual file in the file system.
     
    FileReader(FileDescriptor fd)
    Creates a new FileReader, given the FileDescriptor to read, using the default charset.
     
    FileWriter(FileDescriptor fd)
    Constructs a FileWriter given a file descriptor, using the default charset.
